deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: Log in to your Shopify admin panel and navigate to Online Store > Themes > Actions > Edit code.
Open the 'templates' folder and locate the 'cart.liquid' file.

Click 'Add a liquid code snippet' and paste the following code: <form id='returns-reason-form'> <label for='returns-reason'>Returns Reason:</label> <select id='returns-reason' name='returns-reason'> <option value='defective'>Defective</option> <option value='not-as-described'>Not as described</option> <option value='change-of-mind'>Change of mind</option> <option value='other'>Other (please specify)</option> </select> <input type='text' id='returns-reason-comment' name='returns-reason-comment' placeholder='Please provide a brief description'> <button type='submit'>Submit</button> </form>
Save the changes and navigate to Settings > Checkout.
Under 'Policies', click 'Return policy' and enable the 'Return reason' option.
In the 'Return reason' field, select the 'Custom' option and enter the following code: {{ form.returns-reason-form }}
Save the changes and test the returns flow on your Shopify store.
